method: Parsed literal cubic control coordinates without importing CAD;1001 samples per cubic at evenly spaced parameter values; Euclidean nearest pairs between opposing non-terminal boundaries. Coordinates in millimeters.
excluded_scope: Terminal rounded-cap interior slices approach zero at the endpoint and are not supporting necks. CAD wire validity,3D printability and lane clearance are separate root checks. This is not visual acceptance evidence.
limitations: Discrete sampling is a numerical design screen, not a mathematically rigorous global lower bound or replacement for exact geometry and print gates. No CAD process, physical test or blind recognition review was run.
